pairs.literal: 文明进程 / Civilization
军事能力 / Military
物流仓储 / Logistics
探索发现 / Exploration
殖民建设 / Colony
生存时代 / Survival Age
建立居所、农田和厨房，为第一座工厂储备物资。 / Build a home, fields, and a kitchen to supply your first factory.
机械时代 / Mechanical Age
用管道、传送带和基础冶炼，把手工劳动连接成生产线。 / Connect pipes, conveyors, and basic smelting into your first production lines.
制造阶段凭证物品 / Craft the stage evidence item
电气时代 / Electrical Age
以工业电路、电力和矿物处理支撑自动化与基础防御。 / Use industrial circuits, power, and ore processing to support automation and basic defenses.
信息时代 / Information Age
建立数字仓储和自动合成，让复杂物流变得可管理。 / Build digital storage and autocrafting to keep complex logistics manageable.
重工业时代 / Heavy Industry Age
扩建大型设备、自动矿场和重型防线，稳定供应大宗物资。 / Expand heavy machinery, automated mines, and defenses to supply materials in bulk.
原子时代 / Atomic Age
掌握核能、铱和纳米材料，为航天与量子工业提供基础。 / Master nuclear power, iridium, and nanomaterials for spaceflight and quantum industry.
&l原子时代 / Atomic Age
地球工业的顶峰，下一步是离开摇篮。 / The peak of Earth industry - the cradle is behind.
太空时代 / Space Age
把地球工业延伸到轨道与外星，建设有保障的殖民据点。 / Extend Earth industry into orbit and onto other worlds with reliable colonial outposts.
&l太空时代 / Space Age
工业文明的边界不再是地球。 / The bounds of industry no longer end at Earth.
量子时代 / Quantum Age
建设量子装备与大型工业网络；留在地球也能达到这一阶段。 / Build quantum equipment and large industrial networks. This stage can be reached entirely on Earth.
&l量子时代 / Quantum Age
距离已不再是物流的限制。 / Distance no longer limits logistics.
武装防卫 / Armed Defense
团队已具备枪械制造能力，可以武装守卫与自卫。 / The team can manufacture firearms for guards and self-defense.
自动防御 / Automated Defense
炮塔网络可在无人值守时压制来袭目标。 / A turret network suppresses attackers without crews.
怪潮防御 / Horde Defense
团队已经受住怪潮袭击并保持防线完整。 / The team has weathered a horde assault with the line intact.
重型火力 / Heavy Firepower
EOS 实验室级重火力武器投入使用。 / EOS lab-class heavy weapons are fielded.
远征军备 / Expedition Armament
弹药与武器产能可支撑跨行星远征作战。 / Munitions output sustains interplanetary campaigns.
基础仓储 / Basic Storage
大宗散料有了可检索的集中存放。 / Bulk materials have indexed, centralized storage.
大宗仓储 / Bulk Storage
抽屉网络按压缩级别管理大宗物资。 / Drawer networks manage bulk goods by compression tier.
铁路物流 / Rail Logistics
货运列车承担跨区段批量运输。 / Freight trains carry bulk cargo between districts.
数字物流 / Digital Logistics
ME 网络把仓储与自动合成接入统一索引。 / The ME network indexes storage and autocrafting.
自动生产 / Auto Production
样例供应器让关键部件按需自动产出。 / Pattern providers auto-produce key components.
量子物流 / Quantum Logistics
量子环让跨空间网络合为一体。 / Quantum rings unify networks across any distance.
地球探索 / Earth Scouting
地图与补给让野外行动有据可依。 / Maps and supplies put field work on a plan.
遗物研究 / Relic Research
团队开始收集并利用遗迹遗物。 / The team collects and fields artifacts.
月火考古 / Lunar & Mars Archaeology
月球与火星遗迹进入定期考察范围。 / Moon and Mars ruins are under regular survey.
高危行星调查 / High-risk Survey
金星与水星环境可承受短时考察。 / Venus and Mercury tolerate short expeditions.
深空探索 / Deep Space
团队足迹抵达霜原星与小行星带。 / The team has reached Glacio and the belt.
基地登记 / Base Registered
工业基地已登记，后续活动按本地设施统计。 / The industrial base is registered; activity counts toward local facilities.
稳定后勤 / Stable Logistics
通用仓储网络支撑日常补给调度。 / Warehouse networks sustain daily resupply.
居民岗位 / Crew Posts
村民与雇员开始在基地内担任岗位。 / Villagers and staff hold posts inside the base.
武装驻军 / Armed Garrison
基地有常驻武装力量负责警戒。 / Armed guards keep permanent watch over the base.
外星前哨 / Alien Outpost
团队在其他天体建立了落脚点。 / The team holds an off-world foothold.
永久殖民地 / Permanent Colony
殖民地后勤组件可本地产出并循环维护。 / Colony logistics modules are produced and recycled locally.
